blocks.text: Managing your interview day on Mac

As a corporate recruiter, your Mac is your primary tool for candidate engagement. When you are in a Zoom meeting, you cannot afford to fumble with windows or hunt for buttons. You need to focus on the candidate. Lazur sits in your menu bar and waits for your voice. It does not click buttons, but it can guide you through complex settings or answer questions about your calendar. Hold the Option and Command keys to ask Lazur about your next interview time. It will tell you the candidate name and the job role, allowing you to prepare without leaving your current screen.

Before you start your first interview, ensure your environment is professional. You can [blur your background in Zoom](/how-to/blur-your-background-in-zoom) to hide distractions in your home office. If you frequently share your screen to show company culture decks, learn to [fix a black screen share in Zoom](/how-to/fix-a-black-screen-share-in-zoom) so you do not lose time during the presentation. Always check your camera permissions in System Settings if your video fails to load.

blocks.text: The administrative tax on recruiters is high. You spend hours moving data between your ATS and your email. Instead of typing every meeting summary, use the dictate capability of Lazur. Hold the fn key and speak your notes clearly. Lazur will format them for you at the cursor. This works in any app, including Notion or your ATS. By dictating your thoughts immediately after an interview, you capture accurate details while they are fresh.

Privacy is vital when handling candidate resumes. Lazur respects this. It only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut. No audio or screenshots are stored. This means you can safely ask Lazur to point at a specific field in your ATS or to help you find a document on your desktop. Because Lazur does not edit files, you remain in full control of your candidate data at all times.

Relying on manual note taking that distracts you from active listening.

blocks.text: Advanced workflow for high volume recruiting

If you manage many roles, use multiple desktops on your Mac. Put Zoom on one space and your ATS on another. You can use Lazur to open these apps instantly. Just say open LinkedIn Recruiter or open Workable. This keeps your workspace clean and prevents tab chaos. When you need to find a specific candidate in a long list, ask Lazur to guide you to the search bar. It will draw a circle around the target area so you do not have to squint.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside the Zoom app?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your entire Mac screen. You can use it to find buttons, ask for help with settings, or dictate notes into other apps while Zoom is running.

faq.question: Can Lazur schedule my interviews for me?
faq.answer: Lazur can help you manage your calendar by adding events or checking your schedule. It does not automatically click through external scheduling tools like Calendly, but it can guide you if you get stuck.

faq.question: Is it safe to use voice dictation during a candidate interview?
faq.answer: Yes, but be mindful of your surroundings. Lazur only listens when you hold the fn key. Your voice data is not stored or used to train models.

faq.question: What if I have an Intel Mac?
faq.answer: Lazur supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs running modern versions of macOS.
